good morning — here's a quiet start to the week.

juno's 4-year checkup is coming up in about three weeks, so now's a good time to call the pediatric office and get that on the calendar if it isn't already. those visits tend to cover a physical, vision and hearing checks, and any vaccines that are due at this age — the office can confirm exactly what to expect. wren is part of the picture today too, of course, just keeping pace with their own season of things.

nothing new popped up in local activities this week, so no pressure there. the one easy next step: a quick call to juno's pediatric office to lock in that appointment before the summer fills up.
